desc: Implement per-element contribution with monotonic-stack dominance intervals, asymmetric tie-breaking for min/max, and O(1) bounded-pair counting via triangular-number inclusion-exclusion.
Verify correctness on provided examples ([1,2,3],k=2 -> 20; [1,-3,1],k=2 -> -6) — both confirmed by hand and by in-code assertions.
Stress-test against O(n·k) brute force on 2000 random arrays (n<=9, values in [-4,4], random k) — all passed ("stress OK").
Confirm edge cases: k=1, k>=n, all-equal arrays, strictly monotonic arrays, negative values.
Confirm O(n) time / O(n) memory complexity fits n=80000 constraint.
